AcceptInvitation.description:
Creating an account does not authenticate it; normal login follows, including
any required second factor. Invitation/password are transient secrets.

ApplicationCancellation.description:
Durable personal abandonment of the exact original opaque intention.
No message ID/position: this is not a delivered message or a room event.

header.description: Canonical public Header JSON, base64url. Its u64 fields stay opaque to JS.

AuthenticationStep.description:
Password-only sessions keep the legacy login wire format. This new endpoint
returns a challenge without minting any bearer when an account has a factor.

AvatarCommand.description: Query accompanying the raw PNG/JPEG body, or DELETE. No user-supplied file path.

BeginReauthentication.description:
Persist challenge_id (32 CSPRNG bytes as lowercase hex) and operation_id in
private storage before HTTP. Password/OTP are transient, never persisted.

CallSummary.description: The outcome carried by a direct call's `call_started` row.

duration_seconds.description: Answered calls, once both sides left.

voice.description: Voice sessions in every room, voice channels and ringing direct calls.

ChangeEmailFactor.description:
Pin the displayed contact and installed-factor version before HTTP. The
original operation is retained privately for receipt recovery.

operation_id.description: Absent only for clients predating durable room creation.

voice.description: Sent only to a server announcing `voice`.

through.description: Fixed native position watermark; continue subsequent pages through it.

EmailFactorChange.description: Codes are private presentation data; never log this receipt with Debug.

EmailRemovalReceipt.description: A removal receipt never returns the former private address or a credential.

EncryptedFile.description:
A file of a private message (E2EE_FILES.md): only inside the encrypted
document, never in a cleartext route.

id.description: The upload id, also the server's file id of the opaque object.

key.description: The file key, 32 bytes in base64url without padding.

crypto_identity.description: Legacy UID/salt and KDF parameters must survive an import unchanged.

factor_version.description: Original committed revision, also carried by the encrypted receipt.

filename.description: Absent for encrypted files: the filename lives inside client ciphertext.

media_type.description: For ciphertext this is a declaration, not a verified media type.

FinishFactor.description:
Persist next_token in secure storage before submitting. A retry repeats the
same operation/candidate; it never creates a second session using a spent OTP.

welcome.description: Present only for this device's incarnation and current membership grant.

GroupRoster.description:
Current room authority/grants, independent from a submitted signed plan.
This is an observation: transition acceptance revalidates every version.

group.description: Public head metadata only; never a Welcome or private MLS material.

HistoryBackupPeriod.description: One backed-up period of a generation and its latest signed checkpoint.

next.description: Next page of periods, or none.

count.description: Ranks the server now holds for this period.

next.description: Start of the next page, or none at the end of the entry.

count.description: Records the server now holds for this entry.

sharer_device_id.description: Device that claimed the share by uploading its first page.

ring.description: Direct rooms only: ring the other member. Ignored when a call already rings.

url.description:
Original link in the message, including its fragment. The final URL of
a redirect never replaces the author's navigation target.

voice.description: Accounts connected to this room's voice session.

emoji_catalog_revision.description: A refresh hint; the authenticated catalogue remains authoritative.

limited.description: Above the bounded pilot capacity, forget observations rather than truncate them.

rings.description:
Direct calls where the reader is caller or callee: ringing, or resolved
in the last seconds so both sides see the outcome.

ttl_ms.description: Receiver-relative lifetime; no client wall clock participates in leases.

body.description:
Optional canonical native presentation. Source remains authoritative;
no Rocket.Chat tree, HTML markup, or authenticated resource URL.

call.description: The outcome of a direct call, on its `call_started` row.

personal_mention.description:
Captured mention eligibility for this reader, including the original
recipients of @here. Never persisted in a shared journal payload.

personal_star.description: Present only in account-scoped reads or a journal event for its owner.

quotes.description:
Typed references. Excerpts are resolved for this reader, never supplied
by an author or persisted in a shared journal event.

reply_to.description: A reply belongs to the same room as its root. Replies cannot be roots.

system.description: Server-authored, structured room activity. Never accepted by SendMessage.

messages.description: Newest first. The next page uses the last message's position as `before`.

edit_until.description: UTC deadline; None means no time limit, not permission to edit.

view_position.description:
Consistent read watermark, including unavailable resolutions. Zero from
an older prototype must never authorize or restore a cached excerpt.

email.description: Verified contact, visible only to its owner. Changes use the email proof flow.

ParityContract.description:
Export root for the J0 fixture. Crypto `format` is opaque until the dedicated
specification/review; these types make no algorithm or trust guarantee.

revision.description: Independent private revision: starring never changes the public message.

ProfileReceipt.description: Replays return the original revision; clients refetch the current profile.

ProfileStamp.description: Bounded live invalidation; this never changes the durable room cursor.

PublishHistoryKey.description:
A new history key generation (E2EE_HISTORY_BACKUP.md): the package sealed
under the history code, in a publication signed by the publishing device.

PublishHistoryRequest.description:
A new device's signed history request (E2EE_HISTORY.md). The share and its
records are named by the request fingerprint.

files.description: Files of the current source, readable only through its original room.

membership_version.description: Reader's current membership lifetime in the source room.

quotes.description: Reader-resolved children. Presentation stops at two quote levels.

references.description:
Current source references, also present at the rendering depth limit.
Caches keep these references separately from descendants' private text.

revision.description: Current source revision, distinct from the author's observed revision.

favorite_revision.description: Independent favorite version; reading or receiving a message does not change it.

membership_version.description: Membership lifetime nonce, used to purge a missed withdrawal / rejoin.

ReauthenticationContext.description: Pin proof work to the authenticated account, family and server generation.

ReauthenticationGrant.description: Metadata about proof on the current family; this is never a credential.

RecoverAccount.description:
Operator code resets login credentials; it never recovers E2EE keys or
authenticates the account in place of its normal second-factor login.

RegenerateFactorBackups.description:
Persist the original operation/version privately before HTTP. A retry
recovers the same short-lived code bag on the initiating device.

revoke_previous.description: Root-signed revocation of the previous incarnation, on replacement only.

RenewSession.description:
The next bearer is generated securely and durably saved by the client before
submission. Neither this value nor a Session may be logged with Debug.

RequestEmailRecovery.description:
Anonymous delivery request. Save the random operation before HTTP. No
address, UID, delivery status or recovery credential is returned publicly.

RequestFactorEmail.description:
A new delivery candidate means an explicit resend. Recovery repeats the
same candidate/operation and does not send, mint a code or extend the OTP.

device_revision.description: Exact registered revision and incarnation of the sending controller.

signed.description: Root-signed target device/incarnation; contains no secret material.

oneOf.description: Nobody answered before the ring expired.
The caller left before an answer.

encrypted.description: An MLS group exists. This metadata grants no key or group admission.

read_state.description: Account-scoped state; absent from public journal payloads and old servers.

voice.description: A voice channel: selecting it joins its voice session. Never a direct room.

revision.description: Opaque settings / roster revision, independent from message activity.

files.description: Encrypted files of a private message only (E2EE_FILES.md).

client_side.description: Written by the client (`decorate`), never sent to `commands/run`.

params.description:
i18n key of what follows the name (`Slash_Topic_Params`), or literal
text (`@username`), as Rocket.Chat's `commands.list` gives it.

cursor.description: Only the last page publishes the fixed watermark's replay cursor.

next.description: Opaque page token, authenticated and bound to the same account/generation.

cursor.description: Opaque and bound to the authenticated account and data generation.

messages.description: Newest first, paged by immutable message position.

voice.description: None leaves the flag unchanged; sent only to a server announcing `voice`.

UploadHistoryBackup.description:
Records of ranks `start + 1 ..= start + records.len()` of one period and
the checkpoint signed after them: at most 200 records and 4 MiB.

UploadHistoryRecords.description:
Records of ranks `start + 1 ..= start + records.len()` of one manifest
entry: at most 200 records and 4 MiB.

avatar_file_id.description: Protected resource ID, never an arbitrary URL carrying credentials.

can_publish.description: False in a read-only room for a plain member: listening only.

ring.description: The ring this join started or answered.

VoiceParticipant.description: One account connected to a room's voice session, as the SFU last reported it.

expires_in_ms.description: Receiver-relative time left while ringing; zero once resolved.

description: Single schema root, also used by the TypeScript binding generator.
